newsitem.title: LEBANON: Audi up on second day of trade in Beirut.
newsitem.headline: Audi up on second day of trade in Beirut.

text.p: Shares of Banque Audi rose to $15.5 on their second day of trading on Tuesday from $15 on sharply increased turnover on the Beirut Stock Exchange (BSE).

Turnover in the bank's shares rose to 100,000 shares from 10,000 on Monday. One block of 3,000 shares changed hands on the floor at $15.785 and three blocks totalling 201,380 shares traded outside the floor at $15.
Banque Libanaise pour le Commerce held steady at $12.375 on turnover of 1,197 shares from 1,500 a day earlier.
Solidere A shares rose to $10.625 from Monday's $10.5 and B shares held steady at $11.125. Turnover in the shares rose to 39,687 shares from 33,446 a day earlier.
Turnover on the BSE in all traded stocks was 140,884 shares for a total value of $1,994,414.
There was no trade in the four other firms listed on the BSE: Ciments Libanais, Ciments Blancs, Eternit and Uniceramic.
The LISPI stock index rose 0.5 percent on Tuesday to 81.50.
